plugin.name: command
plugin._long: A plugin to bind key combo (key, button, touch) to execute shell commands.

entry.name: flags
entry._long: Events in which the command will be executed, separated by commas. Supported events are : - `normal` for a key press. - `repeat` for a key press, and repeated while the binding is held. - `release` for when the binding is released. - `always` allows the command to be executed even when the screen is locked or another plugin is active.

option.name: repeatable_bindings
option._long: Bindings which repeat their command if their key or button is held pressed. This option is deprecated, and will be removed in a further release. Please migrate your configuration to use the `bindings` option with the appropriate `flags`.

option.name: always_bindings
option._long: Sets the bindings which are always available, even when screen is locked. This option is deprecated, and will be removed in a further release. Please migrate your configuration to use the `bindings` option with the appropriate `flags`.

option.name: release_bindings
option._long: Sets the bindings which activate on release. This option is deprecated, and will be removed in a further release. Please migrate your configuration to use the `bindings` option with the appropriate `flags`.
